survey.description: Children sorting waste paper at a supplier yard

conversation: I organise waste pickers near Vapi. Shree Paper Recycling buys sorted waste paper from small yards. At one yard I have seen children, I think 11 to 14 years old, sorting paper every day after school hours and some during school hours.
Thank you. How many children and how often?
Around eight children, every day. They work with cutting tools and lift heavy bales. One girl cut her hand badly last month.
Do you know whether the children are paid or related to the adult workers?
They are children of the families who work there. The yard owner pays per kilo to the family. If the family does not reach the quota they lose the work.
Do you know where Shree Paper sells its recycled paper?
Shree makes recycled board that goes to packaging companies, one of them supplies a big European furniture retailer. I have not spoken to Shree yet.
